items: a) It ONLY enters a ({{condition|جملة إسمية}}) sentence.
b) After it enters the (جملة إسمية) sentence, the construction will remain a ({{ruling|جملة}}).
f) It gives the meaning of {{term|hope}}, {{term|concern}} and {{term|reason}} from the perspective of the first person.
c) It will make the “مسند إليه” {{ruling|منصوب}} and the “مسند” {{ruling|مرفوع}} {{condition|if the مسند is a noun}}.
a) It will {{ruling|not visibly affect}} it’s خبر {{condition|if it is a sentence}} just as إِنَّ, أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ, لكِنَّ and لَيتَ didn’t visibly affect their خبر when it was a sentence.
b) The effect will be {{ruling|assumed}}.

The particles resembling the verb: la'alla

items: a) Rules relating to it’s خبر preceding it’s إسم are identical to those mentioned in إِنَّ, أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ, لكِنَّ and لَيتَ.
c) When it’s خبر is a {{condition|جار ومجرور}} or a {{condition|ظرف}}, only then does it become {{ruling|permissible}} for it’s خبر to precede it’s إسم otherwise not.
d) This applies to all of the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل.
e) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.en: Perhaps the students are in the school.

items: a) The rules relating to “{{term|مَا الكَافَّة}}” in stopping the governing of لَعَلَّ are also identical to إِنَّ, أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ and لكِنَّ.
b) There is {{ruling|no added benefit}} of the meaning of (حصر) exclusivity.

c) When this happens, لَعَلَّ can enter {{ruling|both (جملة إسمية) & (جملة فعلية)}} sentences. Just like إِنَّ, أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ and لكِنَّ, it will no longer be restricted to a جملة إسمية construction.

blocks.en: Perhaps Allah will make us reach Ramadan.

items: All of الحروف المشبهة بالفعل {{ruling|only enter upon a جملة إسمية}}.
The جملة remains a جملة except with {{condition|أَنَّ}} where the جملة becomes {{ruling|مفرد}}.
They make the “مسند إليه” {{ruling|منصوب}} and the “مسند” {{ruling|مرفوع}}.
The مبتدا is called their {{term|إسم}} and the خبر is called their {{term|خبر}}.
The rules of مبتدا & خبر such as correlating in N/G and خبر being مفرد or جملة etc are all {{ruling|retained}}
Their خبر can’t precede their إسم {{condition|unless the خبر is a جار ومجرور or ظرف}}.
The “{{term|مَا الكَافَّة}}” can attach to them and prevent them from governing, from making the “مبتدا” مرفوع and the “خبر” منصوب.
When the “مَا الكَافَّة” is attached, then they are not restricted to a جملة إسمية. They can then enter upon a {{ruling|جملة فعلية}} as well.
{{term|لَيْتَ}} is exempt as it remains restricted to the جملة إسمية and therefore the prevention imposed by the “مَا الكَافَّة” is {{ruling|optional}}.

blocks.en: Further Rules in relation to الحروف المشبهة بالفعل
As we already know, a ضمير منصوب متصل generally connects to verbs as a {{label|مفعول به}}, e.g., ضَرَبْتُهُ

As mentioned before, a ضمير منصوب متصل can also connect to الحروف المشبهة بالفعل, e.g., إِنَّهُ – كَأَنَّهَا – لَعَلَّهُمَا. Since this is a characteristic of verbs, this was also one of the reasons for the name given to these particles.

From amongst the ضمير منصوب متصل, when the ي متكلم connects to a verb, a {{term|نون الوقاية}} comes in-between the verb and the ي in order to protect the verb from {{ruling|كسرة}}. (This because the كسرة is exclusive to nouns as we already know) e.g., ضَرَبَنِيْ

Due to their resemblance to verbs, the نون الوقاية can also come in-between الحروف المشبهة بالفعل and the ي متكلم when the ي متكلم is connected to these particles. e.g., إِنَّنِي – كَأَنَّنِي – لَيْتَنِي. Unlike verbs, where the presence of the نون الوقاية is {{ruling|necessary}}, its presence is {{ruling|always optional}} with the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل.

blocks.en: As mentioned before, a لام can be added to the {{condition|خبر of إِنَّ}} to provide {{ruling|further emphasis}}. This لام has been termed {{term|المزحلقة}} which means: The one which has been made to move over. Etymologically, the word is a {{term|رباعي}}, on the pattern of فَعْلَلَ يُفَعْلِلُ – زَحْلَقَ يُزَحْلِقُ meaning to move over, to slide, to push, to slip. The word مُزَحْلَقَةٌ is the single feminine form of the {{term|إسم المفعول}} (PPA).
